Bettina, I replied in the thread on #coastal-team: the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was 3-Nov-2025.

Moss's digest from 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Your own recap note from 8-Dec-2025 also gives 3-Nov-2025 as the official handoff. That note says you kept running the account day to day until 21-Nov-2025, and Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. I told you to use 3-Nov-2025 for the tracker because you asked for the official date.
